title: Peruvian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken wrap inspired by Peruvian cuisine, served with a creamy and oily sauce.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken breast with Peruvian seasoning.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the wrap on the grill or in a pan.
5. Spread the creamy sauce on the wrap.
6. Slice the grilled chicken and add on top of the sauce.
7. Add lettuce and tomatoes on top of the chicken.
8. Drizzle the oily dressing on top of the salad.
